title: A Fake Story
subtitle: A beautiful dream is better than words of truth.

items.text: A Fake Story

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: We accepted you as per the ‘SPDM Listen-in Student Regulations,’ giving you the opportunity to study alongside top scoring students.
Her eyes are as sharp as an eagle's.

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: Otherwise, under the existing school rules, a student your age would be turned away.

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: A lack of formal Arcanist education is only one factor...

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: After all, instilling technical and theoretical knowledge is of no difficulty to us.

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: But noble character, respect for order, and the pursuit of dedicating oneself to the peace of mankind—these require an extensive educational period for our students to fully understand.

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: I believe the St. Pavlov Foundation put much thought into the decision that has allowed you to stand here.

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: You should feel honored.

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: Two distinguished graduates vouched for you and signed the ‘Guardian Responsibility Treaty.’

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: They didn't have to do this. It means that any rule violation on your part will directly impact their personal reputation.

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: So... think carefully about every word you're about to say. You're not just defending yourself...

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: "Don't be selfish," "Think of others"... You grown-ups just love to bring others into everything; shift responsibility for everyone else onto our shoulders! I don't plan on defending anyone.

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: ...I'm willing to accept all the consequences.
Erick grabs the massive stone table. It begins to tremble, as if caught in an earthquake.

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: What are you doing?! Put the table down now!

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: ...I need to talk to Vertin.

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: You took off the arm ring—?

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: But they had already—
She glances at the girl's arm. The band mark is coiling around it like a red python.
"Bang!"
She hurls the stone table into the corner, and it shatters with a deafening crash.

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: I need to ask her something important... I don't want to hurt you.

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: No, Erick... I'm afraid you need to calm down first.

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: Security!
